ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of My extended family? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of My extended family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use My extended family to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say My extended family has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My extended family.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Names of Scriptures able to: has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures able to:.
   D. Use Names of Scriptures able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   C. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

7. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Surah Naas? (1 mark)
   A. Use Surah Naas to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Surah Naas has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Surah Naas with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah Naas.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.
   C. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Enlightened Beings able to: has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Enlightened Beings able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings able to:.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Manners of? (1 mark)
   A. Use Manners of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Manners of has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Manners of.
   D. Apply the teaching of Manners of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in.
   B. Say Belief in has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Belief in to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
